chapters.name: Karbadchata
chapters.text: Tracked armour of the later Ages: heavy battle-chariots of iron, two designs in three marks and three paints. A driver sits in the hull, the commander and gunner under the turret; the gun turns all the way round.

items.name: karbadchata tràd
items.text: Early heavy tracked armour with a 105 mm gun.

items.name: karbadchata troum
items.text: Mk I with the 120 mm gun and a thicker front.

items.name: karbadchata troum làidiri
items.text: Mk IA with composite side skirts and a stronger engine.

items.name: karbadchata kroind
items.text: Low, domed three-crew tank with an autoloaded 125 mm gun.

items.name: karbadchata kroind troum
items.text: Mk II with added turret armour and smoke launchers.

items.name: karbadchata kroind làidiri
items.text: Mk IIA with composite armour and a stronger engine.

chapters.name: Ballaí
chapters.text: Tracks, engine, seat, guns and shells.
